title: SIREN: Towards End-to-End Extreme-Weather Early Warning with Experience-Grounded LLM Agents

claim.summary: SIREN provides an executable extreme-weather environment and experience-grounded agent variants covering hazard analysis, prediction, impacts and warning decisions.

modules.name: Guarded Python execution server
modules.scope_reason: Tool/path validation and isolated workspaces are generic code-execution mechanisms.
evidence_locators: PDF p.5; passage beginning "We therefore route every Python"

modules.name: Case-retrieval instruction template
modules.scope_reason: Appendix K.2 supplies the actual instruction: inspect a collection, rank by task intent/conditions and case metadata, retain at most six question-answer examples, then resume solving. Target task and historical collection are placeholders; no warning-specific score or temporal eligibility calculation is implemented in this retrieval template. Retain temporal/event fields as case metadata and task tags, while classifying this concrete orchestration pattern as GH.

modules.name: End-to-end warning-chain evaluation
modules.scope_reason: Evaluation follows hazard-specific predictive and responsive outputs with per-stage metrics and execution pass rates.
evidence_locators: PDF p.4; passage beginning "For chained tasks"

modules.name: Reference-guided rehearsal and skill refinement
modules.scope_reason: The complete rehearsal/refinement prompts hide the reference answer, execute a selected example, reveal the answer, compare reasoning/tool choices, and retain short procedures while excluding event-specific answers and facts. These are task-placeholder instructions with a reusable procedural-update contract; the implemented update pattern is GH. Unlike FinCon’s fixed investment analyst outputs, this prompt does not require a financial/weather decision variable or task score.
evidence_locators: PDF p.17; Appendix K.2 Skill Refinement Prompt

modules.name: Task-specific hazard-predictor development
modules.scope_reason: Historical hazard cases are converted into supervised train/validation samples and a numerical predictor for the target operational judgment.
evidence_locators: PDF p.6; passage beginning "Guided by a modeling instruction"
